Suits and ties also carry strong cultural associations with professionalism, competence, and authority. The ritual of dressing up can mentally signal to your brain, "I’m stepping into a role where I’m capable and in control," which often translates to better posture, more confident body language, and even improved cognitive clarity. That said, confidence is deeply personal, and what works for one person might not for another. The fact that *your* suit and tie make you feel aligned with your best self is what truly matters.
